title: Fort Beauséjour
geometryBasis: The named fort relation, mapped ground outlines and one-metre GeoNB terrain establish the exact visible star, ditch and walls. The 1756 original manuscript independently confirms the shape.
sectionBasis: Original bare-earth elevation preserves the extant rampart slopes. The Canadian designation record and current named map ways identify the low foundations, powder magazine and stone retaining segments.
limitations: Exposed masonry courses, stone color and the very small interior of the magazine are generalized. Only mapped present-day relics are represented. The detached museum building and wider park access are outside the fort model.
The historical plan establishes the enclosure’s identity. The terrain uses a contemporary bare-earth survey and the layout shows the ruins as they survive.
